hypotheses.H1_interaction_adds_identification: per stage, full median true-candidate probability >= none median true-candidate probability
hypotheses.H2_interaction_adds_forecast_skill: per lead, paired forecast RMSE satisfies full <= none <= static (paired matched-block bootstrap 95% CI on the difference excludes zero in the hypothesized direction)
hypotheses.H3_gap_to_oracle: per lead, report full RMSE / oracle RMSE, and full should be closer to oracle than static is
hypotheses.negative_results_reported: if full does not beat none/static, report that interaction adds no value at ideal conditions; verdicts are frozen and not adjusted post hoc
hypotheses.primary_identification_metric: median true-candidate posterior probability (probability mass); per the G3 gate criterion lesson, per-day argmax is not used for any verdict
